description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldTime, which extends the base class SugarFieldBase. The class provides methods for rendering time input fields in edit and search views, and for saving time data to the database, specifically for the SuiteCRM project. It is part of the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM codebase, handling time-related field functionality.

classes.name: SugarFieldTime
classes.description: A class for managing time fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including rendering input widgets and saving time data.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering the time edit view, including setting display parameters and invoking the Smarty template.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering the time search view, similar to the edit view but for search filters.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Converts user input into database time format and assigns it to the bean's field.
